title: feat(app-shell,react,types): generic product-page blocks (hero, stat, usage-bar, checklist, tile-grid) and the page element's API data source (objectui#12197)
body:
Fixes #12197
Clause-②: yes

Five generic product-page blocks, plus the renderer half of the page element's API data source. The ruling of 2026-10-12 and the hold-lift 6243756425 decide the scope; the claim is 6243827934.

## What lands

**@object-ui/app-shell: five blocks, registered bare and product-neutral** (console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx). Each has declared `inputs` whose descriptions state its defaults, and each takes the API binding as `dataSource`:
- `hero`: title, subtitle?, meta? (with a copy-to-clipboard button), status?, statusTone? (neutral, success, warning or danger; neutral when omitted), primary? / secondary? (element:button or action:button nodes)
- `stat`: label, value (a number is formatted in the viewer's locale), hint?
- `usage-bar`: label, used, limit?, unit?. The width is used / limit, clamped to 0 to 100. An absent or 0 limit is unlimited: the amount used is drawn with no bar. Past the limit the bar is full and red.
- `checklist`: items of label, done and action?; collapsedWhenDone? (false when omitted). Each item is evaluated through useConfigBagEvaluator, so `done: '${data.x}'` works one level down.
- `tile-grid`: items of label, href, icon? and caption?, or one `${…}` hole naming such a list; addTile? of label and href.

**@object-ui/react: SchemaRenderer honours ElementApiDataSourceSchema on every node.** The binding is parsed with the spec's own schema first: a cross-origin or protocol-relative url, a credential key or a non-GET method is refused with the spec's message and nothing is read. The url is read with GET through SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch (ConsoleShell's authenticated, sameOriginOnly fetch; the global fetch when no host gives one), and `path` is selected (dotted keys; a numeric segment indexes a list). The value is bound as `data` in the node's holes, its visibleWhen and its subtree. The loading and error panels are the object binding's. Concurrent identical reads share one request, and nothing is cached. A node without a binding behaves as before. ApiDataSource was not reused: it is a CRUD adapter, and a single read did not fit it.

**@object-ui/types**: strict arms in AnyComponentSchema plus TS twins, so objectui validate accepts the five types. The dataSource prose on the object-bound arms now names the object binding as one of the two shapes of PageComponentSchema.dataSource.

**@object-ui/cli**: KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES regenerated by its script; it gains checklist, hero, stat, tile-grid and usage-bar.

## New names, inputs and accepted shapes (for contract review)
- Registry types: hero, stat, usage-bar, checklist, tile-grid (bare, with no namespace).
- @object-ui/types exports: HeroBlockSchema, StatBlockSchema, UsageBarBlockSchema, ChecklistBlockSchema, ChecklistBlockItemSchema, TileGridBlockSchema, TileGridBlockItemSchema, TileGridBlockAddTileSchema, ProductBlockComponentSchema and the type ProductBlockComponentZodType (zod). Also the TS types HeroBlockProps / HeroBlockSchema, StatBlockProps / StatBlockSchema, UsageBarBlockProps / UsageBarBlockSchema, ChecklistBlockItem / ChecklistBlockProps / ChecklistBlockSchema, TileGridBlockItem / TileGridBlockAddTile / TileGridBlockProps / TileGridBlockSchema, and ProductBlockExpressionHole.
- @object-ui/react exports: useElementApiDataSource, judgeElementApiDataSource, isElementApiDataSourceShape, selectElementApiPath, readElementApi, ElementApiDataSourceStatus, UseElementApiDataSourceResult.
- Accepted shapes: the dataSource of the five arms is the spec's ElementApiDataSourceSchema, by reference. A numeric, boolean or list member the response may supply also accepts exactly one whole-string hole such as `${data.used}`. Copy is the spec's I18nLabelSchema.
- Language-pack keys: none added. The chrome reuses detail.copyToClipboard and detail.copied.

## Where a page type has to be listed (H1)
- objectstack: nothing refuses a bare type. PageComponentSchema.type has an open string arm, and lint's component-type-unknown guards only the spec's reserved namespaces.
- objectui: KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES (os check) was regenerated by script. AnyComponentSchema needs an arm because the registered-types ratchet holds REFUSED_AT_TYPE at 0. PUBLIC_BLOCKS was not joined: the spec has no ComponentPropsMap row for these blocks (see the open questions in the report).

## Reuse (H2)
- tile-grid: the tile classes and the icon gradient moved out of HomeAppsStrip into console/home/launcherTile.ts, string for string. The home strip draws byte-identically (HomeAppsStrip.tilesAreLinks-12305 is green).
- usage-bar: the Progress primitive.
- hero: actions are element:button / action:button nodes, rendered through SchemaRenderer. The copy button follows ConnectAgentWidget's CopyButton pattern.

## Verification
Final head 07b6fc8:
- New tests: 47.
- 79 family files (ElementDataSourceGate, elementDataSourceBlock, PUBLIC_BLOCKS, KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES, AppCard, HomeAppsStrip): 1556 tests green.
- types, react and cli test dirs green.
- app-shell full suite: 12 shards, all green.
- type-check green for types, react, app-shell, cli and console.
- Ablations: removing the data root, the subtree scope, the spec refusal, the collapse and the unlimited rule each turned the predicted tests red, and each restore was proven equal to the HEAD blob.

Screenshots in light and dark, from the preview gallery (`?only=product_blocks`, `&theme=dark`): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/tree/claude/issue-12197-evidence/evidence/12197

## Acceptance notes
- The Shadcn Progress primitive does not pass `value` to its Radix root, so aria-valuenow is missing everywhere it is used. usage-bar sets it itself. The primitive is a No-Touch file and was not edited.
- The spec seat's objectstack lint card (pointer 6129423804) is the seat's call. These blocks bind data through holes, not field-name props.
